t: This is The Magazine, a restaurant building in London designed by Zaha Hadid. Hadid was an Iraqi British architect, born in Baghdad, who studied mathematics before enrolling at the Architectural Association in 1972. Looking for an alternative to traditional architectural drawing, and influenced by Suprematism and the Russian avant-garde, she adopted painting as a design tool. She is recognised as a key figure in the architecture of the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries. So this restaurant is the work of one of the central architects of that period.
